causal_path_preserving_quotient.representative_selection: lexicographically smallest canonical raw fixture within each class; representatives then lexicographically ordered before opaque execution IDs are assigned
causal_path_preserving_quotient.why_not_action_pair_only: Action-pair-only quotient would collapse distinct guard paths and could hide a runtime realization defect even when the final action is equal.

changed_causal_axes: schedule_paused false branch: old bare lowercase false remains truthy string; new renders boolean false
current_schedule_preset: old compares literal-evaluated integer active_slot to string digits and falls through to slot4; new casts active_slot to int
new source normalizes scalar/list selectors and aggregates presence/pause existentially
left_home rechecks aggregate anyone_home instead of only triggering entity

fixed_profile.times: four strictly ordered zero-padded slot times; fixtures place now() inside the requested active_slot

new_native_law.single old entity_id: normalized to one-element list and then existentially evaluated

cases.name: other_presence_entity_still_home
cases.required_new_behavior: left_home path must not apply vacation preset

cases.name: other_pause_switch_still_on
cases.required_new_behavior: pause_off path must not resume schedule

nonclaims: The 144-state historical frontier does not count configurations containing multiple selected presence/pause entities because the old selector did not admit that configuration shape.
Notification-service interpolation changes are outside the thermostat consequential-action claim.
Mismatched weekday/Saturday/Sunday routing is frozen as an unchanged precondition and is not a frontier dimension.

old_native_law.current_schedule_preset: always slot4 on active_slot values 1..4 because active_slot is literal-evaluated to int but compared with strings '1','2','3'

reachability_constraints: pause_off fixes pause_on=false after the triggering transition
arrived_home fixes presence_home=true after the triggering transition
left_home fixes presence_home=false after the triggering transition
for non-presence state-trigger paths, presence_home is canonicalized to false when presence mode is disabled because the value is semantically ignored
for non-pause state-trigger paths, pause_on is canonicalized to false when pause mode is disabled because the value is semantically ignored

shared_historical_configuration_domain.new_only_multi_entity_behavior_role: secondary extension witness only; it cannot change compatibility counts
shared_historical_configuration_domain.principle: Frontier membership is defined only over configurations that an old-version installation could already possess and that the new source explicitly accepts after upgrade.
